gold: Left maxillary giant cell reparative granuloma (GCRG)

selector.rationale: The presence of a heterogeneous mass with solid and cystic components in the left maxillary sinus, erosion of the orbital floor, and displacement of the inferior rectus without muscle invasion, along with the biopsy results showing a spindle cell process, supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Fibrous Dysplasia
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence and lower score
